# v2 hyperparameter search on the synthetic worlds (generated by harness/hpo.py)

PROTOCOL Part II §V12.1 item 23. Synthetic worlds only, **no trials**. All settings: V1b's structure, anchor 0, no buy-and-hold prior, costs 2 bp + 3 bp half-spread. *Capture* = median gain / median oracle gain over the seeds (gain = net Sharpe − buy-and-hold). Score = mean capture over W-swing and W-regime, −1 if the median W-null gain is below -0.05. Raw rows: `experiments/reports/v2_hpo/runs_r*.csv`.
